environment.description: IoT telemetry gateway deployed on-premises in OT network segment (VLAN 847) behind Palo Alto PA-5260 with App-ID profile 'iot-telemetry-strict' that performs deep packet inspection on HTTP POST bodies. The PA-5260 threat prevention profile (TP-2847) includes custom signatures detecting Jinja2/Python expression patterns ({{.*__.*}}, {{.*config.*}}, {%.*import.*%}) in JSON string values and resets the TCP connection. Additionally, the application's key_provider module links against a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (firmware 7.8.2) via PKCS#11 interface where slot 7 holds the HMAC verification key with CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE and CKA_SENSITIVE=TRUE. The HSM enforces that C_Verify operations require the message to have been signed by a key in the same partition - meaning only messages actually signed by registered devices pass verification. The HSM partition policy (partition-iot-prod, policy serial CT7842) enforces per-key access control where verify operations on the signing key require the calling application to present a valid partition challenge-response derived from the HSM's internal monotonic counter.

config.network: Palo Alto PA-5260, VLAN 847, App-ID iot-telemetry-strict, TP-2847
config.key_storage: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, PKCS#11, slot 7, CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE
config.hsm_partition: partition-iot-prod, policy serial CT7842, monotonic counter challenge
config.firewall_signatures: Custom Jinja2 expression detection in JSON POST bodies
config.auth_enforcement: HSM C_Verify requires message signed by registered device key in same partition
